blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recurrent–attention hybrid language models (LMs), which interleave attention and recurrent layers, are increasingly used to combine the efficiency of the recurrent layers with the strong performance of attention layers.
Prior work suggests that attention and recurrent layers offer complementary pathways to use past information: attention supports precise memory recall from earlier tokens, while recurrent layers support consolidation of disparate information over long contexts.
However, we observe that simply having access to both pathways does not mean that hybrid LMs are effectively using them.
When we analyze how much the models rely on each pathway, we find a substantially greater reliance on attention than on the recurrent state.
Standard supervised fine-tuning improves overall performance but does not improve how the two memory pathways are coordinated: the model becomes more reliant on information propagated by attention layers, while its use of information propagated by recurrent layers remains limited.
To encourage better coordination between the two memory pathways, we add an auxiliary loss that limits attention’s access to earlier context while the recurrent state propagates through the full sequence.
This objective encourages the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway alongside attention.
It improves overall performance, with particularly strong gains on tasks involving longer contexts or requiring information aggregation, consistent with the strengths of recurrent layers observed in analysis.
Crucially, this imbalance and the benefit of our auxiliary loss generalize: they apply to multiple recurrent-attention LMs in question-answering and agentic tasks, as well as to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory.
Together, our findings show that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not ensure their effective use, and that targeted supervision is needed to better coordinate them. 1 1 1 Code in https://github.com/amy-hyunji/Balancing-Memory-Pathways
blocks.zh:
经常-注意混合语言模型(LMs),它使注意力和反复层相互交织,越来越多地被用来将经常层的效率与注意层的强效性结合起来。
先前的工作表明,关注层和经常性层为使用过去的信息提供了互补的途径:关注支持从早先的符号中精确地召回内存,而经常性层则支持将不同的信息合并到长期背景下.
然而,我们注意到,仅仅通过两种途径并不意味着混合LMs正在有效地使用它们。
当我们分析模型对每条路径的依赖程度时,我们发现对关注的依赖大大超过对反复出现的状态的依赖。
标准监督的微调改进了总体性能,但没有改进两个内存路径的协调方式:模型更加依赖关注层所传播的信息,而经常层所传播的信息的使用仍然有限.
为了鼓励两个记忆路径之间更好的协调,我们增加了一个辅助损失,限制注意力进入更早的背景,而反复出现的状态则通过完整的序列传播.
这一目标鼓励该模式通过经常性途径与关注一道保留和使用信息。
它改善了总体业绩,在涉及较长背景或需要信息汇总的任务上取得了特别显著的进展,这与分析中观察到的经常层的长处是一致的。
关键的是,这种不平衡和我们附带损失的好处是概括的:它们适用于问答和代理任务的多重重复式 LMs,以及结合不同记忆形式的基于注意力的 LMs.
我们的调查结果表明,仅仅提供多种内存途径并不能确保有效使用这些途径,需要进行有针对性的监督来更好地协调这些途径。 1 1 1 代码载于https://github.com/amy-hyunji/Balance-Memory-Pathways

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recurrent–attention hybrid language models ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) , which consist of recurrent and attention layers, leverage efficient recurrent computation and expressive attention memory to allow flexible access to prior context.
These architectures contain two memory pathways for retaining and using past information: attention and recurrent layers.
Prior work ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Michalak and Abreu, 2025 ; Bick et al., 2026 ) has analyzed distinct characteristics and strengths of these components: attention layers support precise memory recall by directly accessing earlier information, while recurrent layers synthesize information distributed across long contexts.
Extending these findings, we observe that attention plays a larger role when the answer appears directly in the context or can be found from a single piece of evidence, whereas the recurrent state plays a larger role when the answer must be inferred rather than copied or requires combining multiple pieces of evidence across the context.
These complementary strengths motivate an important question: How well do hybrid LMs use both memory pathways, and how can their coordination be improved?
blocks.zh:
经常性-注意混合语言模型(Quen Team,2026;Ren等,2025;Dong等,2024;NVIDIA等,2025),由经常性和注意层组成,能利用高效的经常性计算和表达式关注内存,可以灵活地访问之前的上下文.
这些架构包含保留和使用过去信息的两个内存路径:关注和反复层.
先前的工作(Lee等人,2025年;Michalak和Abreu,2025年;Bick等人,2026年)分析了这些组件的不同特点和长处:关注层通过直接取用更早的信息支持精确的记忆回想,而经常性层则合成了分布在长处的信息.
在扩展这些结论时,我们注意到,当答案直接出现在上下文中或可以从单一证据中找到时,注意力发挥更大的作用,而当必须推断而不是复制答案时,经常性状态则发挥更大的作用,或者需要将多个上下文的证据组合在一起。
这些相辅相成的优势引发了一个重要问题: 混合 LM 如何使用两种内存路径,如何改进它们的协调?

图1 经常性混合 LMs 的内存路径概况和我们的调查结果.
(中间) 经常性-注意混合 LMs中的两个内存路径扮演着不同的角色: 注意支持精确地记忆回想早期的符号,而经常性状态则支持在长上下文中汇总信息.
(Right )随着标准SFT(L S F T LQQSFT}),该模型主要依赖于关注,并低估了反复出现的路径.
我们添加了一个辅助损失(L r e c L_{rec}),它掩盖了对过去上下文的关注,只允许模型通过反复层访问.

blocks.en:
We first examine how existing hybrid LMs use their attention and recurrent memory pathways.
We find that having both pathways does not mean that models use both effectively; models retain most of their accuracy even when the recurrent pathway’s access to past information is limited
(30.2% → \rightarrow 20.2%), whereas accuracy drops substantially when the same restriction is applied to attention layers
(30.2% → \rightarrow 5.1%).
This imbalance in memory utilization persists even after standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on downstream tasks such as question answering.
Although the overall performance improves, the gains are mostly from better utilization of attention layers whereas their use of the recurrent pathway remains limited (Figure 1 , Standard SFT box).
blocks.zh:
我们首先审查现有的混合LM如何利用它们的注意力和反复出现的内存路径.
我们发现,拥有两种途径并不意味着模型有效地使用两种途径;即使经常途径获取过去信息的机会有限,模型仍保持大部分准确性。
(30.2%~相差20.2%),而当对注意力层施加相同的限制时,精度会大幅下降。
(30.2% = 右倾 5.1%).
即使在对回答问题等下游任务进行标准监督微调(SFT)后,这种内存利用率的不平衡依然存在.
虽然总体业绩有所改善,但收益主要来自对关注层的更好利用,而它们对经常路径的使用仍然有限(图1,标准SFT框)。

blocks.en:
To address this imbalance in memory utilization, we add an auxiliary loss that complements standard SFT by encouraging the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway.
In an auxiliary forward pass, we restrict the attention layers’ access to past context, requiring the model to access it through recurrent states.
This simple intervention improves question-answering performance, with average absolute accuracy gains of 3.9% on Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and 5.2% on Nemotron-H-4B-Instruct ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) across six datasets.
Adding the auxiliary loss also substantially improves performance when past information is propagated only through recurrent layers, suggesting increased use of recurrent memory.
The gains are particularly large on longer-context datasets (8.0%) compared to shorter context (0.2%), consistent with more effective use of recurrent layers’ previously identified strength in processing long contexts.
Reversing the restriction to encourage attention leads to smaller gains, suggesting that the improvement from the auxiliary loss depends on which pathway is encouraged, with greater improvement from strengthening the underutilized recurrent pathway (Figure 1 , With Auxiliary Loss box).
blocks.zh:
为了解决内存利用的这种不平衡,我们增加了一个辅助损失,通过鼓励该模型通过经常性路径保留和使用信息来补充标准SFT。
在辅助的前进通道中,我们限制关注层对过去背景的接触,要求模型通过反复出现状态访问.
这种简单的干预提高了问答性能,在Qwen3.5-4B(Quen Team,2026年)和Nemotron-H-4B-Instruct(NVIDIA等,2025年)上平均绝对精度增益为3.9%,在6个数据集中均达到5.2%.
加上辅助损失也大大提高了以往信息只通过反复层传播时的性能,说明经常内存的使用增加.
与较短的背景(0.2%)相比,较长文本数据集的收益特别大,这与以往在处理长期背景时发现的惯用层实力得到更有效的利用是一致的。
扭转这种限制以鼓励注意会导致收益较小,这表明辅助损失的改善取决于鼓励哪条路径,而加强利用不足的经常性路径则会得到更大的改进(图1,附带损失框)。

blocks.en:
The benefits of auxiliary supervision also extend to agentic tasks, where agents must explore, accumulate observations, and use them to choose subsequent actions.
When averaged across both models, adding recurrent auxiliary supervision improves the success rate by 3.5% and 9.3% on Quest and Treasure tasks in TextWorld ( Côté et al., 2019 ) , and by 22.0% and 13.5% on the PutNextLocal and GoToObjMaze tasks in BabyAI ( Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ) , respectively.
We observe that the larger gains on BabyAI mirror our question answering results, where the auxiliary loss tends to show stronger improvement on longer contexts; BabyAI trajectories (avg. 134.0 steps) are substantially longer compared to TextWorld (avg. 42.2 steps).
blocks.zh:
辅助监督的好处还延伸到代理任务,代理任务必须探索,积累观测,并利用它们选择后续行动.
当在两种模式中平均增加经常性辅助监管时,TextWorld(Côté等,2019年)的Quest和Treasure任务的成功率分别提高3.5%和9.3%;BabyAI(Chevalier-Boisvert等,2019年)的PutNext Local和GoToObjMaze任务的成功率分别提高22.0%和13.5%.
我们观察到,在BabyAI上取得更大的进展反映了我们的问题答案结果,辅助损失往往在较长的上下文上显示出更强劲的改善;BabyAI轨迹(av. 134.0步)与TextWorld(av. 42.2步)相比要长得多.

blocks.en:
We further examine how the auxiliary loss affects the use of past information.
When models are allowed to retry after failures, with their previous attempts stored in memory so that they can revise their answers or actions ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) , models trained with the auxiliary loss recover more successfully, improving the cumulative recovery rate over standard SFT by 16.6% on question answering and 19.2% on agentic tasks.
In question answering, the gain is especially large on multi-evidence questions compared to single-evidence questions (30.3% vs. 2.8%).
We attribute this to the auxiliary loss encouraging greater use of recurrent layers, which we observe to play a larger role in multi-evidence questions.
In the agentic setup, when given multiple suboptimal successful demonstrations, we observe that agents trained with the auxiliary loss more often generate trajectories shorter than any provided demonstrations (6.0% on average), with larger gains when the demonstrations are longer.
Finally, the same imbalance and the strength of the auxiliary loss generalize to attention-based LMs with multiple memories: standard SFT favors one memory pathway over another, and adding auxiliary supervision that encourages the use of the underutilized pathway increases usage of the pathway and improves overall performance in question-answering.
Across architectures and tasks, our findings highlight that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not lead to balanced, complementary use; models must instead be trained to coordinate these memory pathways.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步审查辅助损失如何影响过去资料的使用。
当模型被允许在故障后进行再试,之前的尝试被存储在内存中,以便修改答案或动作(Shinn等人,2023;Zhao等人,2024)时,辅助损失培训的模型恢复得更成功,比标准SFT的累计回收率在回答问题上提高了16.6%,在代理任务上提高了19.2%.
在回答问题时,与单一证据问题(30.3%对2.8%)相比,多证据问题的收益特别高。
我们将此归因于鼓励更多使用重复层的辅助损失,我们观察到这些层在多证据问题上发挥更大的作用。
在代理设置中,当获得多次次最优成功示威时,我们观察到,受过辅助损失训练的特工往往比任何提供的演示都产生更短的轨迹(平均6.0%),在示威时间更长时产生更大的收益.
最后,同样的不平衡和辅助损失的强度概括到具有多重记忆的基于注意力的LMs:标准SFT偏好一个内存路径,并增加辅助监督,鼓励使用利用不足的路径,增加路径的使用,提高问答中的整体性能.
在整个架构和任务中,我们的调查结果强调,仅仅提供多种内存路径并不能导致平衡、互补的使用;相反,必须培训模型来协调这些内存路径。

blocks.en: 2 Background & Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和相关工作

blocks.en: In this section, we provide an overview of recurrent-attention hybrid LMs in Section 2.1 , then review and extend prior findings on the roles of the recurrent and attention memory pathways in Section 2.2 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们概述第2.1节中的经常-注意混合 LMs,然后审查和扩大先前关于第2.2节中经常和注意记忆途径的作用的调查结果。

blocks.en: 2.1 Recurrent-Attention Hybrid LMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 经常-留置混合

blocks.en:
Recurrent-attention hybrid LMs ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) integrate attention and recurrent layers to combine strong language modeling performance with computational efficiency.
An attention layer computes each token’s representation by attending to the current and preceding tokens, providing direct access to past information at the cost of quadratic computation in sequence length and KV cache that grows linearly.
A linear recurrent layer , such as Mamba2 ( Dao and Gu, 2024 ) or Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , instead updates a fixed-size state as new tokens are processed, enabling computation that scales linearly with sequence length and constant memory size. Throughout the paper, we refer to such linear recurrent layers simply as recurrent layers .
Many hybrid LMs interleave these layers, combining attention’s direct access to earlier tokens with recurrent layers’ compact integration of past information ( Kimi Team et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) .
These models often match or outperform fully attention-based models despite using relatively few attention layers, while gaining efficiency from the larger portion of recurrent layers.
blocks.zh:
经常性混合 LM(Ren等,2025年;Dong等,2024年;NVIDIA等,2025年;Zhang等,2026年)将关注和反复层融合到一起,将强大的语言建模性能与计算效率相结合.
注意层通过关注当前和之前的信号来计算每个信使的表示,提供直接访问过去信息的机会,其代价是顺序长度的四相计算和线性增长的KV缓存。
线性常态层(如:Mamba2(Dao and Gu, 2024)或Gated DeltaNet(Yang等, 2025)),取而代之的是随着新符号的处理而更新了固定大小的状态,使得计算能够以序列长度和恒定内存大小来线性地缩放. 整个论文中,我们把这种线性重复层简单地称为重复层。
许多混合 LMs 互通这些层,将注意力直接取用更早的标志与经常层的紧凑整合过去的信息结合起来(Kimi Team等,2025;NVIDIA等,2025)。
这些模型尽管使用相对较少的注意层,但往往匹配或超过完全基于注意的模型,同时从经常层的较大部分获得效率.

blocks.en: 2.2 Roles and Strengths of Attention and Recurrent Memory Pathways
blocks.zh: 2.2 注意的作用和力量以及经常性记忆途径

blocks.en:
Prior work has identified distinct roles for attention and recurrent components in hybrid LMs.
Attention is particularly important for precise retrieval, where removing attention causes severe retrieval failure in the evaluated hybrids ( Michalak and Abreu, 2025 ; Bick et al., 2026 ) .
Recurrent components contribute substantially to language modeling, where removing the recurrent pathway causes larger degradations in likelihood-based evaluation than removing attention ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Borobia et al., 2026 ) .
While these studies characterize the distinct strengths of the two memory pathways, they do not analyze whether hybrid LMs make effective use of both pathways’ strengths or how to improve their use.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作已经确定了在混合 LMs 中引起注意和重复部分的独特作用。
注意对于精确检索特别重要,因为去除注意会导致被评价的杂交体严重检索失败(Michalak and Abreu,2025;Bick等人,2026.).
经常性组成部分对语言建模大有帮助,因为去除经常性途径比去除注意力更可能导致基于可能性的评价退化(Lee等人,2025年;Borobia等人,2026年)。
虽然这些研究说明了两种记忆路径的特长,但没有分析混合LMs是否有效利用两种路径的长处或如何改进它们的使用。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Increase in negative log-likelihood (y-axis) for Qwen3.5 when ablating attention or recurrent layers compared to unablated model, where high value indicates a greater contribution of the ablated component .
Attention contributes more to retrieval QA, while recurrent layers contribute more to language modeling.
blocks.zh:
图 2: 与未缩放的模型相比,当调出注意力或反复层时,Qwen3.5的负对数相近(y-轴)增加,其中高值表明被缩放的组件的贡献更大.
注意更能帮助检索QA,而经常层更能帮助语言建模.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Accuracy (y-axis) of Qwen3.5 under Full (unrestricted) and Attention-only (past context accessible only through attention) across question types.
Percentages show the fraction of Full accuracy retained under Attention-only: high and low retention indicates greater reliance on attention and recurrent state, respectively.
blocks.zh:
图3:在Full(无限制)下为Quen3.5的精确度(y-轴)和只注意度(过去上下文只能通过注意获得),跨问题类型.
百分比显示只注意下保留了完全准确的一小部分:高保留和低保留表明分别更多地依赖注意力和经常状态。

blocks.en:
We first revisit the distinct roles of attention and recurrent layers identified in the studies reviewed above.
Following the setup from Lee et al. (2025) , we use Based NQ ( Arora et al., 2024 ) to evaluate memory recall and PG19 ( Rae et al., 2019 ) to evaluate language modeling, and measure the increase in negative log-likelihood (NLL) when either attention or recurrent layers are ablated relative to the unablated model using Qwen3.5.
Figure 3 shows a pattern consistent with prior findings: on retrieval QA, ablating attention increases NLL more than ablating recurrent layers (5.3 vs. 1.5).
The pattern reverses for language modeling, where ablating recurrent layers has a larger effect (1.3 vs. 3.7).
This contrast suggests that attention contributes more to precise recall, while recurrent layers contribute more to aggregating information across the context.
blocks.zh:
我们首先重新审视上文所审查的研究中确定的关注和反复层次的独特作用。
在从Lee等人(2025年)的设定后,我们使用Based NQ(Arora等人,2024年)来评价内存召回和PG19(Rae等人,2019年)来评价语言建模,并测量在使用Quen3.5的被关注或被重复的地层相对于被忽略的模型被淡出时负对数(NLL)的增加.
图3显示的规律与先前的发现一致:在检索QA上,分解注意力会增加NLL多于分解常态层(5.3对1.5).
语言建模的模式倒置,其中平分反复层的效果较大(1.3对3.7.
这一对比表明,注意力更有助于准确的召回,而经常性层则更有助于汇总整个背景的信息。

blocks.en:
We then extend the analysis to different question types to test whether the two memory pathways have distinct roles or strengths for different information needs using the datasets described in Section 3 .
We consider two distinctions.
First, we classify a question as verbatim if its normalized gold answer appears in the source context, and as non-verbatim otherwise.
Second, we classify questions as single-evidence or multi-evidence based on the number of evidence required to answer them, where evidence annotations are available.
We match the number of examples across the two categories in each distinction.
Figure 3 compares pathway use across question types.
We measure attention-only retention as the fraction of full-model accuracy preserved when cross-context information is accessible only through attention layers; higher retention indicates greater reliance on attention and less on recurrent state.
We observe that retention is higher for verbatim than non-verbatim questions (63% vs. 46%) and for single-evidence than multi-evidence questions (60% vs. 50%).
This aligns with the findings above: attention layers play a larger role in recovering precise details, but contribute less when information must be abstracted or integrated across the context.
Further details are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
然后,我们把分析扩大到不同的问题类型,以测试两种内存路径在使用第3节所描述的数据集满足不同信息需求方面是否有不同的作用或优势。
我们认为有两个区别。
首先,如果一个问题正常的黄金答案出现在源上下文中,我们将其归类为逐字回答,否则则归类为非逐字回答。
第二,我们根据有证据说明的回答问题所需的证据数量,将问题归类为单一证据或多证据。
在每个区别中,我们比对这两类例子的数目。
图3比较了各问题类型使用的途径。
我们衡量只注意保留,作为仅通过注意层才能获取跨文本信息时保存的完整模型精度的一部份;保留较多表明更多地依赖注意,较少依赖经常状态。
我们看到,逐字记录问题(63%对46%)和单一证据问题(60%对50%)的保留率高于多证据问题。
这与上述结论是一致的:关注层在恢复准确细节方面发挥更大的作用,但在必须抽象或综合整个背景信息时,贡献较小。
详情见附录A。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: We experiment over two recurrent-attention hybrid LMs: Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and Nemotron-H-4B-Instruct ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . Qwen3.5-4B contains 24 Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and 8 full-attention layers. Nemotron-H-4B-Instruct consists of 24 Mamba2 ( Dao and Gu, 2024 ) and 4 full-attention layers.

blocks.en:
We train all models using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) on all layers with rank 16, scaling factor 32, and dropout 0.05.
We use AdamW with a learning rate of 1 ​ e − 4 1e^{-4} , a cosine learning rate schedule, a warmup period covering 3% of training steps, and an effective batch size of 16.
Since objectives with an auxiliary loss require additional computation, we halve the number of optimization steps to match the total training compute with standard SFT.
Unless otherwise specified, we use the same optimization setting across all compared variants.

我们利用LORA(Hu等,2021年)在所有层次上培训所有型号,等级为16等分,比例为32等分,辍学率为0.05等分.
我们使用 AdamW 的学习率为 1 e - 4 1 e - 4 e - 4 } , 余弦学习率表, 热身期 占训练步骤的3%, 有效批量规模为16.

除非另有说明,我们对所有比较的变体使用相同的优化设置。

blocks.en:
We experiment on long-context question answering and long-horizon agentic tasks, which are two common settings for studying memory in which the model needs to retain and use information from earlier contexts or interactions for strong performance ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) .
For Question Answering , we pool training examples from four datasets so that the model is trained over diverse context lengths and reasoning types: DROP ( Dua et al., 2019 ) , HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , Qasper ( Dasigi et al., 2021 ) , NarrativeQA ( Kočiský et al., 2017 ) .
This yields 12k training and 2k validation instances.
We evaluate each dataset separately, and additionally evaluate on MINTEval ( Lee et al., 2026 ) and MuSR ( Sprague et al., 2024 ) , leading to a total of 8.2k test examples with an average context length of 84k tokens.
For Agentic Tasks , we experiment over TextWorld ( Côté et al., 2019 ) and BabyAI ( Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ) , where agents must explore the environment, accumulate information through sequences of observations and actions, and use it to make subsequent decisions. The environments differ in their observation spaces, action spaces, and in the structure of their trajectories.
In TextWorld, we train on Quest and evaluate on both Quest and Treasure.
In BabyAI, we train on MiniBossLevel and evaluate on PutNextLocal and GoToObjMaze.
Further details are in Appendix B .

我们实验长文本问题解答和长视野代理任务,这是研究内存的两个常见的设置,模型需要保留和使用早期背景或相互作用的信息来进行强性能(Packer等,2024;Zhao等,2024;Shinn等,2023).
对于问答,我们汇集了四个数据集的培训实例,以便该模型在不同的上下文长度和推理类型中接受培训: DROP (Dua等, 2019)., HotpotQA (Yang等, 2018)., 卡斯珀. (Dasigi等, 2021)., NarrativeQA (Kočiský等, 2017.).

对于代理任务,我们通过TextWorld(Côté等,2019年)和BabyAI(Chevalier-Boisvert等,2019年)进行实验,其中代理必须探索环境,通过观察和行动序列来积累信息,并利用这些信息来做出后续决定. 环境在它们的观测空间,动作空间,以及它们的轨迹结构上各不相同.

blocks.en: 4 Standard SFT Favors Attention over Recurrence
blocks.zh: 4 标准 SFT 优先关注重现

blocks.en: Key Observation: Standard SFT increases recurrent-attention hybrid LMs’ use of the attention pathway, but yields little improvement in their use of the recurrent pathway.
blocks.zh: 关键观察: 标准 SFT 增加了对关注路径的经常性关注混合 LMs 的使用,但在使用经常性路径方面几乎没有什么改进。

blocks.en:
In Section 2.2 , we observed complementary strengths and roles of the two pathways: attention supports precise recall, while recurrent layers integrate information across the context.
Thus, in this section, we examine whether standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leads the model to use both pathways in ways that leverage these complementary strengths.
We first define attention-only and recurrent-only conditions to analyze and assess the model’s use of each memory pathway (Section 4.1 ).
We then evaluate how overall performance and pathway utilization change after SFT on question answering and agentic tasks (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在第2.2节中,我们看到了这两种途径的互补性优势和作用:注意有助于准确召回,而经常性层则综合了整个背景的信息。
因此,在本节中,我们审查标准监督微调(SFT)是否导致该模型利用这两种途径利用这些互补优势。
我们首先确定只注意和重复的条件,以分析和评估模型对每个内存路径的使用情况(第4.1节)。
然后,我们评价SFT在回答问题和代理任务(第4.2节)之后的总体业绩和途径利用的变化。

blocks.en: 4.1 Disentangling two memory pathways
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 排除两个内存路径

blocks.en:
To analyze how past information is carried through attention and recurrence, we divide each input into a past portion and a current portion, and selectively restrict which memory mechanism can transfer information from the past to the current input.
For example, in question answering, the past portion corresponds to the context and the current portion to the question.
We use full to denote the unmodified condition, in which both attention and recurrent layers can propagate information from the past to the current portion.
We construct two complementary interventions, recurrent-only and attention-only ; these indicate which mechanism can carry information from the past to the current portion .
In the recurrent-only setting, attention cannot access the past portion, so past information reaches the current portion only through the recurrent state; the attention-only setting does the opposite. In both, all layers remain active within each portion.

为了分析过去的信息是如何通过关注和重现来传递的,我们把每个输入分为一个过去部分和当前部分,并有选择地限制哪些内存机制可以将信息从过去转移到当前输入.
例如,在回答问题时,过去部分对应上下文,现在部分对应问题.
我们完全用来表示未经修改的条件,即关注层和反复层都可以将信息从过去传播到目前部分。
我们构建了两个互补的干预措施,即经常性的和只注意的;这些干预措施表明,哪个机制可以把信息从过去传递到目前部分。
在只重复的设置中,注意不能访问过去的部分,因此过去的信息只能通过重复状态到达当前部分;只注意的设置是相反的. 在这两个方面,每一部分的所有层都保持活跃。

blocks.en: 4.2 Memory Pathway Utilization after SFT
blocks.zh: 4.2 SFT之后的内存路径利用

blocks.en:
We evaluate both the original and SFT-trained models under the full, attention-only, and recurrent-only conditions defined in Section 4.1 .
As shown in Figure 5 , the SFT-trained model ( Standard SFT ) achieves 34.6% QA accuracy on Qwen3.5 under the full condition, compared to 30.2% for the original model ( Base ).
Attention-only accuracy also increases from 20.2% to 25.0%, whereas recurrent-only accuracy remains nearly unchanged (5.1% to 5.0%).
We observe a similar pattern on the agentic Quest task: full success rate rises from 27.0% to 78.5%, attention-only also rises from 6.0% to 52.0%, while recurrent-only improves only slightly, from 2.5% to 4.0%.
These results indicate that the model retains a large portion of its full performance when recurrent layers are restricted to local information (attention-only), but drops sharply when attention is restricted to local information (recurrent-only).
This gap widens after SFT.
blocks.zh:
我们根据第4.1节规定的全部、只注意和只经常使用的条件,评价训练有素的原始模式和SFT模式。
如图5所示,SFT训练模型(标准SFT)在全能状态下在Quen3.5上达到34.6%的QA精度,而原始模型(Base.)则达到30.2%.
只注意的准确度也从20.2%提高到25.0%,而只注意的准确度几乎保持不变(5.1%到5.0%)。
我们观察到在代理查询任务上也有类似的模式:完全成功率从27.0%上升到78.5%,只关注率也从6.0%上升到52.0%,而只关注经常性的只是略有改善,从2.5%上升到4.0%。
这些结果表明,当经常层被限制在局部信息(只注意)时,模型保留了很大一部分的全能性能,但当注意力被限制在局部信息(只注意经常性)时则急剧下降.
这一差距在SFT之后扩大.

blocks.en:
This shift toward the attention pathway also appears across the question types discussed in Section 2.2 .
We observe that attention-only retention, the fraction of full-model accuracy preserved under the attention-only condition, increases for all question types (Figure 5 ).
The gain is larger for question types that already relied more on attention: verbatim and single-evidence questions show an average increase of 25.5% compared to 19.2% for non-verbatim and multi-evidence questions.
blocks.zh:
第2.2节所讨论的问题类型中也出现了这种向关注途径的转变。
我们看到,只注意保留,即完全模型精度在只注意条件下保留的部分,对所有问题类型都有所增加(图5)。
对已经更依赖关注的问题类型来说,收益更大:逐字记录和单一证据问题显示,与19.2%的非逐字记录和多证据问题相比,平均增长25.5%。

blocks.en:
Together, these results show that standard SFT improves overall performance but does not lead to balanced use of the two memory pathways: the model becomes more reliant on attention, while its use of recurrent pathway changes little.
Given the distinct strengths of these pathways observed in Section 2.2 , we next investigate whether encouraging more effective use of both pathways can improve memory coordination and further enhance overall performance.
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,标准SFT提高了总体性能,但并没有导致平衡地使用两个内存路径:模型变得更加依赖关注,而其经常路径的使用变化不大.
鉴于第2.2节中观察到的这些路径的显著优势,我们接下来将调查鼓励更有效地利用这两个路径是否能够改善记忆协调并进一步加强总体业绩。

blocks.en: 5 Encouraging Recurrent Memory Use Improves Performance
blocks.zh: 5 鼓励经常性内存使用提高性能

blocks.en: Key Observation: Adding an auxiliary loss that encourages the use of recurrent pathway increases its utilization and improves overall performance while maintaining utilization of the attention pathway.
blocks.zh: 关键观察: 增加一个辅助损失,鼓励使用经常性路径,增加其利用率并改进总体性能,同时保持对关注路径的利用。

blocks.en:
In Section 2.2 , we observe that attention and recurrent layers play complementary roles, each carrying important information for different types of questions.
However, Section 4.2 shows that standard SFT does not effectively utilize both pathways, instead increasing the model’s reliance on attention while leaving the recurrent pathway underutilized.
Thus, in this section, we examine whether adding auxiliary loss that encourages the use of recurrent pathway (Section 5.1 ) leads to better memory coordination and stronger overall performance (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在第2.2节中,我们注意到注意和反复出现的层次起着相辅相成的作用,每一个层次都载有不同类型问题的重要信息。
然而,第4.2节表明,标准SFT没有有效利用这两种途径,而是增加了该模式对关注的依赖,同时使经常途径没有得到充分利用。
因此,在本节中,我们审查增加鼓励使用经常性路径的辅助损失(第5.1节)是否会导致更好的内存协调和更有力的总体业绩(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Recurrent Auxiliary Supervision
blocks.zh: 5.1 经常性辅助监督

blocks.en:
We augment standard SFT with an auxiliary loss that uses the same supervised next-token prediction objective but masks attention to the preceding context, a mechanism commonly used to control information flow in LMs ( Mu et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2019 ) .
Unlike attention, recurrent layers remain unrestricted: they process the entire sequence and propagate their state from the preceding context.
Thus, during the auxiliary forward pass, information from the preceding context can influence the answer only through recurrent memory, encouraging the model to retain and use information throughout the recurrent pathway.
We jointly optimize the standard SFT loss ( ℒ SFT ​ ( θ ) \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SFT}}(\theta) ), computed without these restrictions, and the auxiliary loss ( ℒ rec ​ ( θ ) \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}}(\theta) ): ℒ ⁡ ( θ ) = ℒ SFT ​ ( θ ) + λ ​ ℒ rec ​ ( θ ) , \mathcal{L}(\theta)=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SFT}}(\theta)+\lambda\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}}(\theta), where θ \theta denotes model parameters and λ \lambda controls the strength of the auxiliary supervision. 2 2 2 Ablation of different λ \lambda in Appendix C.1

To understand which part of the objective drives these gains, we conduct analysis with several training variants.
For these ablations, we consider L a ​ t ​ t ​ n L_{attn} , which is the counterpart of L r ​ e ​ c L_{rec} : it blocks recurrent-state propagation from the preceding context while leaving attention unrestricted.
We compare training with auxiliary losses alone ( L r ​ e ​ c L_{rec} or L a ​ t ​ t ​ n L_{attn} ), and adding L a ​ t ​ t ​ n L_{attn} to standard SFT ( L S ​ F ​ T + L a ​ t ​ t ​ n L_{SFT}+L_{attn} ).

Figure 6 further shows that adding L a ​ t ​ t ​ n L_{attn} increases attention-only accuracy from 25.0% to 28.0%, while recurrent-only accuracy remains much lower at 11.3%, indicating continued imbalance between the two memory pathways.
These results suggest that strengthening the underutilized recurrent pathway is more effective than further encouraging the use of attention.
Finally, training with only the auxiliary loss ( L a ​ t ​ t ​ n L_{attn} or L r ​ e ​ c L_{rec} ) yields lower average accuracy than standard SFT ( L S ​ F ​ T L_{SFT} ) when averaged over both models, by 1.3% and 2.7%, respectively. This suggests that restricted losses are most effective as auxiliary objectives alongside unrestricted SFT.

blocks.en: In this section, we examine whether encouraging the use of the recurrent pathway also improves the model’s ability to learn from past failure and successful trajectories ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . We then examine whether our observations generalize to attention-based LMs with multiple memories.

blocks.en:
We analyze whether models can recover from their own errors when given additional attempts, with previous failed attempts provided in context ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) .
For question answering, we evaluate on MINTEval, which includes long contexts and both single-evidence and multi-evidence questions about the same context.
Figure 7 (left) shows the cumulative recovery rate (y-axis) as the maximum number of attempts (x-axis) increases.
Across all questions (solid lines), recovery rates increase with additional attempts under both standard SFT and SFT with auxiliary loss.
Adding the auxiliary loss consistently improves recovery, with an average absolute gain of 16.6% across attempt budgets.
The gains are particularly large on multi-evidence questions: averaged across attempt budgets, recovery improves from 27.3% to 57.6%, compared to 14.8% to 17.6% on single-evidence questions.
For agentic tasks, we apply the same retry setup to TextWorld, providing previous failed trajectories in context.
The auxiliary loss improves cumulative recovery by an average of 19.2% (Figure 10 in Appendix).
Recovery continues to improve with additional attempts under SFT with the auxiliary loss, whereas standard SFT plateaus.
These results suggest that the auxiliary loss helps models more effectively use failed attempts stored in memory to recover from errors.

为了回答问题,我们对MINTEval进行了评估,它包括较长的背景,以及同一背景的单一证据和多证据问题。

对于代理任务,我们对TextWorld应用相同的再试设置,在上下文中提供之前失败的轨迹.

We examine whether agents can use successful but suboptimal trajectoreis to develop more efficient strategies.
We provide multiple successful demonstrations of varying lenghts, which may contain unnecessary steps, and measure how often the agent generates a successful trajectory shorter than the shortest demonstration.
As shown in Figure 7 (right), adding the auxiliary loss improves this rate by an average of 6.0%, with larger gains as demonstrations length increases relative to the optimal path.
These results suggest that the auxiliary loss helps agents more effectively use successful demonstrations stored in memory to develop more efficient strategies.

blocks.en:
We find that both the imbalance in memory use and the benefits of auxiliary supervision extend to attention-based LMs with multiple memory types (textual and latent memory).
As shown in Figure 8 , standard SFT ( SFT ) with both memories achieves 24.1% accuracy, far below the Oracle , which selects the better of the two single-memory predictions for each example (32.0%) and even below the text-only model (25.9%).
This suggests that access to both memories does not ensure effective use of their complementary strengths.
Even when trained jointly with standard SFT, the model remains biased toward using textual memory.
Adding an auxiliary loss that encourages the use of both memory pathways improves accuracy to 28.6%.
Further analysis shows that this improvement is accompanied by increased use of latent memory while largely preserving use of textual memory (Appendix C.3 ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we show that recurrent-attention hybrid LMs tend to rely predominantly on the attention pathway despite the complementary strengths of their recurrent layers, and that standard SFT further increases attention use while yielding little improvement in recurrent memory use.
We show that adding a simple auxiliary loss that encourages use of the recurrent pathway improves utilization of both memory pathways and overall performance.
These findings generalize across multiple recurrent-attention hybrid LMs, across question answering and agentic tasks, and to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们表明,尽管经常层具有互补优势,但经常-注意混合LMs往往主要依赖注意途径,标准SFT进一步提高注意使用率,但经常内存使用几乎没有改进。
我们显示,增加一个简单的辅助损失,鼓励使用经常路径,可以改善内存路径和总体性能的利用。
这些结论概括了多种经常性的混合语言、问答和代理性任务,以及将不同记忆形式结合起来的基于注意力的语言。

blocks.en: A.1 Verbatim vs. Non-Verbatim Questions

blocks.en:
We first distinguish questions based on whether their answers can be directly recovered from the source context.
We define a question as verbatim when its normalized gold answer appears in the source document and non-verbatim otherwise.
Approximately 34.6% of the test examples (about 2.8k examples) are verbatim and to match the number of instances for the two categories, we randomly sample the same number of examples from the remaining non-verbatim questions.

blocks.en: A.2 Single- vs. Multi-Evidence Questions
blocks.zh: A.2 单一对多证据问题

blocks.en:
We next examine whether the relative strengths of the two memory pathways change with the amount of evidence required to answer a question.
Using the evidence annotations provided by the datasets, we divide questions into those that rely on a single piece of evidence and those that require multiple pieces of evidence.
Among the test examples, approximately 30.2% (about 2.5k) are single-evidence and 39.7% (about 3.3k) are multi-evidence, and the rest does not provide explicit evidence annotations.
To balance the two categories, we randomly sample the same number of multi-evidence questions as single-evidence ones, resulting in around 2.5k examples each.

blocks.en: B.2 Agentic Setup

blocks.en:
We report success rate, the fraction of games in which the agent completes the goal within the step limit.
For TextWorld, we set the maximum number of steps to 100 and use 1,000 training, 150 validation and 200 test games, generated with non-overlapping random seeds.
For BabyAI, we use the official maximum number of steps for each level with 100 instances for each training level (MiniBossLevel) and test levels (PutNextLocal, GoToObjMaze).

blocks.en:
We examine whether agents can learn from their own failures: when the agent fails to complete a game, it retries the same game up to a maximum number of attempts, with its previous trajectories provided in context.
When evaluating over TextWorld, as shown in Figure 10 , the auxiliary loss improves the cumulative recovery rate by 19.2% on average.

blocks.en: C.3 Generalizes to Attention-Based Models
blocks.zh: C.3 对关注型模式的概括

blocks.en: To examine whether our findings generalize to attention-based models, which do not have multiple built-in memory pathways, we provide them with two commonly used forms of memory: textual ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) and latent ( Mu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) memory. We conduct the experiment with Qwen3-4B-Instruct model.
blocks.zh: 为了检查我们的结论是否泛指没有多重内置内存路径的以注意力为基础的模型,我们为他们提供了两种常用的内存形式:文字(Packer等,2024;Yu等,2026;Wang等,2025;和潜伏(Mu等,2024;Li等,2024)内存. 我们用Quen3-4B-指令模型进行实验.

blocks.en: C.3.1 Textual & Latent Memory.
blocks.zh: C.3.1 文字和Latet记忆。

blocks.en:
For textual memory , we summarize a given document and train the model to generate the answer conditioned on the resulting summary and the question.
For latent memory , following prior work ( Mu et al., 2024 ; Ge et al., 2024 ) , we represent each document as a layer-wise KV prefix with K K memory slots.
Specifically, we append K K learnable memory tokens to the end of the document and run the resulting sequence through the model.
Because these memory tokens follow the document, they can attend to and aggregate information from the preceding tokens.
We retain the key-value representations at these K K memory tokens positions from every transformer layer; together, these representations form the latent memory.
Training proceeds in two stages: in Stage 1, we train the model to encode document information into these latent memory slots using reasoning supervision.
In Stage 2, we provide the latent memory as a prefix cache to the model, which is trained to generate the answer conditioned on the latent memory and the question.
The answer-generation loss is backpropagated through the entire computation, including the forward pass used to construct the latent memory.
blocks.zh:
对于文字内存,我们总结一个给定的文档,并训练模型生成以所产生的摘要和问题为条件的答案.
对于潜在内存,在之前的工作(Mu等,2024;Ge等,2024)之后,我们将每个文档作为带有K K内存槽的分层KV前缀来表示.
具体来说,我们将K K 可学习的内存符号附加到文档的结尾,并通过模型运行产生的序列.
由于这些内存符号跟随了文档,因此可以关注并汇总来自前作符号的信息.
我们从每个变压器层保留这些 K K 内存符号位置的键值表示;这些表示共同构成潜在的内存.
训练分两个阶段进行:在第一阶段,我们利用推理监督将文件信息编码到这些潜在的内存槽中。
在第二阶段,我们提供了潜在的内存作为模型的前缀缓存,该模型被训练出以潜在内存和问题为条件生成答案.
答案生成损失通过整个计算,包括用来构建潜在内存的前传.

blocks.en:
We compare textual and latent memory under a range of matched memory budgets along two axes: whether the answer appears word-for-word in the context (verbatim vs. non-verbatim) and whether answering requires one or multiple pieces of evidence (single- vs. multi-evidence). See Appendix A for details.
As shown in Figure 11 , textual memory shows a larger advantage when the required information is directly recoverable (verbatim) or localized in a single piece of evidence (single-evidence), whereas latent memory becomes more competitive when the answer must be inferred (non-verbatim) or requires combining multiple pieces of evidence (multi-evidence).
This suggests that textual memory is especially effective when prediction relies on precise information explicitly retained in memory, whereas latent memory is relatively more effective when information must be transformed or aggregated.

blocks.en: C.3.2 Standard SFT Favors Textual Memory over Latent Memory
blocks.zh: C.3.2 标准 SFT 偏好文字内存,高于Latet内存

blocks.en: Key Observation: Naively training hybrid memory with standard SFT fails to coordinate its components effectively, instead favoring textual memory.
blocks.zh: 关键观察: 以标准SFT进行自然训练的混合内存未能有效地协调其组件,而是倾向于文本内存.

blocks.en:
For naive hybrid memory , we follow the same Stage 1 as for latent memory, training the model with reasoning supervision to encode document information into the K K latent memory slots.
In Stage 2, we provide both the latent memory and textual memory to the model and train it with the same question-answering objective.
Thus, both memory representations are jointly available during training, without any additional supervision that explicitly encourages coordination between them.

对于天真的混合记忆,我们遵循与潜在记忆相同的阶段1,训练模型进行推理监督,将文档信息编码入K潜在记忆槽.
在第二阶段,我们向模型提供潜在的内存和文字内存,并以同样的回答目标对其进行训练。
因此,在培训期间,两种记忆表述都是共同提供的,没有任何其他监督明确鼓励它们之间的协调。

blocks.en:
Figure 8 shows question answering performance with different types of memory, using a textual memory budget of 8k tokens ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and a latent memory budget of 128 slots ( Ge et al., 2024 ) .
The Oracle , which selects the correct prediction whenever either single-memory model succeeds, measures the complementary information available across the two memories.
It outperforms the single-memory models ( Text and Latent ) by 10.1% on average, indicating that the two memories capture complementary information.
However, the model trained with both memories under standard SFT ( SFT ) remains 7.9% below the Oracle and even falls below the Text (24.1% vs. 25.9%), suggesting that naively combining the two memories does not ensure better coordination or improved performance, and can instead lead them to interfere with each other.
These results show that the presence of complementary information across memories does not by itself guarantee effective coordination under joint training .

blocks.en: Key Observation: Adding an auxiliary loss that encourages the model to use a designated memory pathway improves memory coordination and overall performance. The gains are largest when pathway selection follows the verbatim criterion identified in Appendix C.3.1 .

blocks.en:
The previous section shows that naive joint training leads to imbalanced use of the two memory pathways, with the model relying predominantly on textual memory and underutilizing information captured by latent memory.

We also apply auxiliary supervision without per-example role assignment: Latent-aux and Text-aux assign all examples to the latent or text role, respectively, and Unrouted applies both auxiliary terms to every example.
